boundaries.synchronousMs: Public command return, or trusted beforeinput through completed input event; includes schema, projection, history and event observers. No paint is inferred.
boundaries.notificationMs: Command/input start through scheduled onChange delivery, configured changeDebounceMs=0.
boundaries.settledRenderOpportunityMs: Start through notification then two animation frames, scheduled independently of native driver return; a render opportunity, not proof of a paint. No-ops include an explicit 50ms notification quiescence window.
boundaries.trace: Separate Chrome trace: actual Layout/Paint/UpdateLayoutTree records within marked command+notification+frame windows.
boundaries.allocation: Separate V8 statistical allocation profiles; sampled byte estimates include the full edit/undo/redo/reset sequence and oracle checks. Not retained heap size.
boundaries.retention: Separate forced-GC observations of released event envelopes, changes arrays, before/after data and inline roots, snapshot blocks/data/inline roots, with live positive controls. Counts are WeakRef observations, not distinct objects or proof about every nested descendant. Heap usage is an observation, not an allocation count.
